title: console: the Studio app's own root still renders `StudioHomePage`, the page the maintainer calls retired. Decide whether to retire it, and what the root shows instead
body:
Ruled: 6105451919 · letter A1 · 2026-10-11T04:32Z

Filing class: **a maintainer-requested card.** The maintainer asked for it in the `domain:ui` seat 3 session (`session_01B1gHb9baeX7oioD5sHVm7z`), verbatim, 2026-10-11: 「要开卡：Studio 首页要不要退役」. It carries an open question from that seat's round report, raised by the contract review of PR objectui#12091. ~~⛔ Not graded or routed here: triage grades.~~ Ruled A1 (6105451919): `StudioHomePage` retires, the Studio app root resolves to its own first navigation item; the `domain:ui` lane claims it.

## The contradiction

- **objectui#12079's body:** the maintainer says `StudioHomePage` is "Studio's old home, retired a long time ago, and nobody should land on it".
- **objectui `main` `5330afd1`, after objectui#12079 landed (PR objectui#12091):**
  - Only an app whose navigation serves nothing now gets the empty state. That was the card's scope.
  - The Studio app itself still lands on the page. In `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, the app index route falls back to `return <StudioHomePage />` for "a navigation with no landing: the metadata-admin 'Studio' app, whose nav is built from `component` items the landing resolver does not walk".
  - The sidebar keeps a matching "Studio home" entry: `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`'s `isStudioHomeActive`, the app root with its package scope.
  - `appServesNoNavigation.ts` records the choice: "Its root keeps rendering `StudioHomePage`".
- **The other entry point:** the `/studio` route (`apps/console/src/components/StudioRoute.tsx`) is a separate builder surface. Home's Studio button and `StudioDesignSurface` both navigate there.

So both of these are true on `main`: the page is retired in the maintainer's words, and it is the live root of `/apps/<studio app>`, linked from that app's own sidebar.

## The decision this card asks for

- **A. Retire it.** The Studio app's root goes somewhere else, and `StudioHomePage` with its sidebar home entry goes away.
  - Where the root goes is part of the decision: for example, a redirect to `/studio`, or to the first `component` item of the Studio app's navigation (the package management page).
  - Its in-repo readers move with it: `useRecentItemLabel.ts` and `ContextSelectors.tsx` name it, and so do its tests.
- **B. Keep it.** The page stays as the Studio app's overview, and objectui#12079's wording is corrected on the record. Nothing in code changes.

## What a fix would touch (for triage, not a ruling)

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`: the app index route's last fallback.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`: the Studio home entry.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/StudioHomePage.tsx` and its export from `views/metadata-admin/index.ts`. That index is not the package entry: `@object-ui/app-shell`'s `exports` map is `.` and `./styles.css`, and `src/index.ts` does not name it. To be re-checked when taken.

Dedupe: an objectui issue search for `StudioHomePage`, retire, Studio app root and home page finds objectui#12079 (closed, the empty-navigation card this follows) and four unrelated closed cards.
